paper_id: Federated Learning on Non-iid Data via Local and Global Distillation
title: Federated Learning on Non-iid Data via Local and Global Distillation
motivation: 联邦学习中非独立同分布数据导致通信开销大且性能下降
problem_framing: 将非iid问题分解为客户端过拟合与服务器端权重偏移两部分
key_insight: 利用dropout机制实现单模型自蒸馏，用随机噪声经自适应更新生成蒸馏样本替代外部数据集
method_signature: FedSND: 自蒸馏(客户端)+噪声蒸馏(服务器端)双模块协同
evaluation_criteria: 多数据集(CV/NLP)不同α下的测试准确率与通信轮次收敛速度
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: 自蒸馏在non-iid场景下易过拟合局部模型导致收敛震荡
evidence_for_taste: the performance of the other algorithms decreases significantly
noise distillation is more useful than self-distillation
the lower threshold results in higher quality noise
more local epochs tend to lead to greater variation across client models
the specific value of the sample is no longer important
thinking_moves: 将知识蒸馏问题从外部教师模型转化为单模型内部机制
把client-server问题拆解为过拟合与权重偏移分别处理
用随机噪声代替真实样本实现无数据蒸馏
观察dropout输出差异作为模型鲁棒性的度量信号
